headlines.title: Exxon Wants to Repeat Its Guyana Success in Trinidad. Should You Buy the Stock Now or Wait for the First Well?
headlines.summary: Trinidad offers upside, but Exxon's existing business remains strong.

headlines.title: ExxonMobil (XOM) Stock May Be 10% Undervalued As Kashagan Risk Looms
headlines.summary: ExxonMobil Holdings has delivered a powerful run in recent years, and that puts fresh attention on a simple issue for anyone looking at the stock today: how much of the current share price is really supported by the cash the business can generate over time. Over the past 5 years the stock has returned 226.7%. This raises the question of how much of that move reflects durable cash flow strength versus changing sentiment toward big oil.

headlines.title: Has ExxonMobil Stock Become A Different Bet?
headlines.summary: At 22.2 times earnings, ExxonMobil (XOM) stock trades near the S&P 500's 22.5. Shareholders paying that multiple need a clear view of the underlying assets, and the priorities inside the company have shifted. During the fiscal Q3 2024 call, executives promoted Pioneer Natural Resources, a producer ExxonMobil now owns outright. Management no longer emphasizes that deal. So what does management talk up instead.

headlines.title: All You Need to Know About Exxon (XOM) Rating Upgrade to Buy
headlines.summary: Exxon (XOM) has been upgraded to a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy), reflecting growing optimism about the company's earnings prospects. This might drive the stock higher in the near term.

headlines.title: Chevron vs. ExxonMobil: Which Energy Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
headlines.summary: ExxonMobil's 8.9% net margin outpaces Chevron's 6.7%, but Chevron's Guyana expansion could reshape the competitive landscape.

description: ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation engages in the exploration and production of crude oil and natural gas in the United States, Canada, and internationally. The company operates through Upstream, Energy Products, Chemical Products, and Specialty Products segments. Its Upstream segment explores for and produces crude oil and natural gas. The Energy Products segment offers fuels, aromatics, and catalysts, as well as licensing services. Its Chemical Products segment manufactures and sells olefins, polyolefins, and intermediates. The Specialty Products segment offers finished lubricants, basestocks, waxes, synthetics, elastomers, and resins. It is also involved in the manufacture, trade, transport, and sale of crude oil, natural gas, petroleum products, petrochemicals, and other specialty products; and pursuit of lower-emission and business opportunities, including carbon capture and storage, hydrogen, lower-emission fuels, Proxxima resin systems, carbon materials, low-carbon data center, and lithium. In addition, the company offers aviation fuel. It sells its products under the Exxon, Esso, and Mobil brands. The company was formerly known as Exxon Mobil Corporation and changed its name to ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation in July 2026. ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation was founded in 1870 and is headquartered in Spring, Texas.
